charge_description: Taking fish in a stream called Thornton Beck above the town of Thornton
raw_record: Summary conviction of John Law of Grosmont Haggs in the parish of Egton farmer and John Watson of Aislaby near Whitby gardener for taking fish in a stream called Thornton Beck above the town of Thornton in the parish of Thornton, which stream and fishery were the property of John Gilby of Thornton clerk and John Ward of Yedingham in the East Riding clerk

defendants.other_details: of Grosmont Haggs in the parish of Egton

involved_persons.role: Owner of the stream and fishery

involved_persons.other_details: of Yedingham in the East Riding
involved_persons.role: Co-owner of the stream and fishery
